payload.title: Right-size Amplify compute and fix caching (Papyrus-web caches nothing; verify STANDARD vs STANDARD_8GB price)
payload.description:
Facts: all 9 apps are STANDARD_8GB; October 7,077 min → $70.77, i.e. $0.01/min; `cms.buildComputeType` already exists in `site-config.ts`. Papyrus-web `amplify.yml` has `cache: paths: []` and runs `sudo dnf install python3.12` + venv + pip every build. CMS specs already cache `.next/cache/**/*` and `.npm/**/*`.
Steps:
1. Cost Explorer (read-only): group October by `USAGE_TYPE` for Amplify in papyrus-production; find whether a separate usage type/price exists for STANDARD_8GB vs STANDARD. If both bill $0.01/min, keep 8GB (type-check OOM history; faster is cheaper here) and close that part with the finding. If STANDARD is cheaper, switch one low-risk site (Pilobol.us) first, watch build time + memory in the job log, then roll out via `buildComputeType` per site.json.
2. Papyrus-web: add `cache.paths: [.npm/**/*, .build/python/**/*]`; guard the dnf install with `test -x .build/python/bin/python ||`.
3. Verify the `.next/cache` restore actually hits (Amplify log shows "cache restored"); if the cache key misses after each Papyrus bump, note it, that is expected.
Acceptance: before/after minutes per build on this story; Gherkin for Papyrus-web "second build reuses the Python venv". No fixed cap on anything.
